neighbours.label: the last digit of a year in a statement of when something began (began only as late as 1958)
fire: Regular records of rainfall began only as late as 1878.
Daily tide readings started only as late as 1920.
Measurements of ozone began only as late as 1957.
Yearly counts of the herd started only as late as 1968.
Systematic mapping of the coast began only as late as 1848.
Weekly surveys of the river began only as late as 1909.
Official counts of whales started only as late as 1946.
Careful study of the glacier began only as late as 1890.
quiet: Regular records of rainfall are kept in the town hall.
Daily tide readings are posted near the harbor.
Measurements of ozone are published each spring.
Yearly counts of the herd are done by the rangers.
Systematic mapping of the coast is done by the navy.
Weekly surveys of the river are paid for by the state.
Official counts of whales are shared with other nations.
Careful study of the glacier is planned by the university.
